articles.title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Sank Russian Warship at Naval Base in Libya
articles.summary: Ukraine sank a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya using naval drones, said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky . Forces deployed seven Ukrainian-made drones that struck and sank the Russian corvette Mercury, which was carrying a combat helicopter, Zelensky said Monday morning. A second ship, the Russian container carrier MV ANGARA, which Zelensky said was being used to “transport weapons,” was also hit. articles.title: South Korean Education Minister Resigns After Backlash Toward Anti-AI Measures

articles.title: Why the World’s Climate Talks Broke Down—and What Happens Now
articles.summary: COP31 , the United Nations’ annual climate change summit, ended on Sunday without consensus on an overarching climate deal after about two days of overtime in Antalya, Türkiye. The annual conference brings together delegates to shape and formalize an approach to combating the effects of global warming . This year, the main dispute was whether the agreement should explicitly call for a transition away from fossil fuels . articles.title: How to Deal with Anxiety
articles.summary: Hands down, anxiety is the most common mental health issue affecting Americans today. Over 19% of adults in the U.S. meet criteria for an anxiety disorder in any given year. Many often don’t recognize these difficulties, or mistake them for signs of a physical health condition. As a psychologist, I can tell you that worrying is a normal part of life.
